name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixed federated libraries silently failing to sync for any friend who hadn't explicitly configured per-friend sharing yet ("1 source(s) failed, cached data preserved", 0 items refreshed). Every sync call needs some remote user id to browse as - that's inherent to Jellyfin's own per-user library API, not something this plugin can skip - but GetItemsAsync/GetItemAsync (the actual content-fetching calls sync uses) just gave up with a warning when no user id was configured, even though the config page's own tooltip already promised a fallback to "an administrator account on their server". That fallback existed for playback (GetPlaybackInfoAsync) and library listing (GetLibrariesAsync) already, just not for the two calls sync itself depends on. Sync now falls back the same way everywhere: prefer an admin account on the remote, cached in-memory per server so it's only resolved once.

(0.0.67's release asset was rebuilt from a stale bin/ directory and still reported AssemblyVersion 0.0.66 despite meta.json saying 0.0.67 - Jellyfin's installer appears to treat a version string as already-satisfied once attempted once, even after the GitHub asset was corrected, so this is the same fix re-released under a fresh version number rather than reusing 0.0.67.)

200 tests.
